key_catalyst: Operational Strait of Hormuz blockade amid a third night of U.S.-Iran strikes
reasoning: The Hormuz threat has escalated from conflicting closure fears on July 13 to an operational blockade, collapsing vessel traffic, continued U.S.-Iran strikes, and sharply higher oil. The pre-market recovery rests largely on an unconfirmed favorable CPI forecast and appears insufficient to absorb the worsening geopolitical and inflation risk.
